preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 1000 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of pairs n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t))
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements a_i in the array are between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The total sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES\n') if any(all(a_i + a_j == x for a_i, a_j in zip(sorted(a), sorted(a)[::-1])) for x in set(a)) else stdout.startswith('NO\n')
postconditions.description: The output starts with 'YES\n' if it is possible to throw out all elements of the array by selecting an appropriate x and performing the operations, otherwise it starts with 'NO\n'.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split('\n')) == 2 * n + 2 if stdout.startswith('YES\n') else True
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES\n', the total number of lines in the output is 2 * n + 2, where n is the number of pairs in the test case. Otherwise, the condition is trivially true.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.split('\n')[2:]) if stdout.startswith('YES\n') else True
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES\n', each of the next n lines contains exactly two integers. Otherwise, the condition is trivially true.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) + int(line.split()[1]) == x for line in stdout.split('\n')[2:]) if stdout.startswith('YES\n') else True
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES\n', the sum of the two integers in each of the next n lines equals x. Otherwise, the condition is trivially true.
